title: 'Everyone does naarebaazi in democracy but ... ': Why Supreme Court told Chandigarh admin to 'argue on merits' in Bhagwant Mann case
summary: The Supreme Court will hear the Chandigarh administration's plea regarding an FIR. This FIR was against Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann and other AAP leaders.
